Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid

  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def load():

    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    hl=None; vL=None
    for r in range(H):
        if all(x==2 for x in g[r]): hl=r
    for c in range(W):
        if all(g[r][c]==2 for r in range(H)): vL=c
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    ocells={(r,c):g[r][c] for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]!=bg and g[r][c]!=2}
    rs=[r for r,_ in ocells]; cs=[c for _,c in ocells]
    r0,r1=min(rs),max(rs); c0,c1=min(cs),max(cs)
    out=[[bg]*W for _ in range(H)]
    if hl is not None:
        if r1>hl:  # object below, move up to touch line
            off=(hl+1)-r0
            news={(r+off,c,v) for r,c,v in ocells.items()}
            br=max(r+off for r,c,v in ocells)+1
        elif r0<hl:  # object above, move down
            off=(hl-1)-r1
            news={(r+off,c,v) for r,c,v in ocells.items()}
            br=min(r+off for r,c,v in ocells)-1
        else:  # adjacent: no move
            news=set()
            br=r0-1
        for r,c in ocells: out[r][c]=bg
        for r,c,v in news: out[r][c]=v
        for c in range(W): out[br][c]=8
    elif vL is not None:
        if c1>vL:   # object right, move left
            off=(vL+1)-c0
            news={(r,c+off,v) for r,c,v in ocells.items()}
            bc=max(c+off for r,c,v in ocells)+1
        elif c0<vL: # object left, move right

            bc=min(c+off for r,c,v in ocells)-1
        else:
            news=set(); bc=c0-1
        for r,c in ocells: out[r][c]=bg
        for r,cc,v in news: out[r][cc]=v
        for r in range(H): out[r][bc]=8
    return out

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    hl=None; vL=None
    for r in range(H):
        if all(x==2 for x in g[r]): hl=r
    for c in range(W):
        if all(g[r][c]==2 for r in range(H)): vL=c
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]!=bg and g[r][c]!=2]
    rs=[p[0] for p in cells]; cs=[p[1] for p in cells]
    out=[[g[r][c] for c in range(W)] for r in range(H)]
    news=[]
    if hl is not None:
        if min(rs)==hl+1 or max(rs)==hl-1:   # already adjacent
            pass
        elif max(rs)>hl:   # below -> move up so top edge at hl+1
            sh=(hl+1)-min(rs)
            news=[(q[0]+sh,q[1],q[2]) for q in cells]
        else:              # above -> move down so bottom edge at hl-1
            sh=(hl-1)-max(rs)
            news=[(q[0]+sh,q[1],q[2]) for q in cells]
    else:
        if min(cs)==vL+1 or max(cs)==vL-1:
            pass
        elif max(cs)>vL:   # right -> move left so right edge at vL-1
            sh=(vL-1)-max(cs)
            news=[(q[0],q[1]+sh,q[2]) for q in cells]
        else:               # left -> move right so left edge at vL+1
            sh=(vL+1)-min(cs)
            news=[(q[0],q[1]+sh,q[2]) for q in cells]
    for rr,cc,v in news: out[rr][cc]=v
    for q in cells: out[q[0]][q[1]]=bg      # clear old object
    if hl is not None:
        nrs=[p[0] for p in (news if news else cells)]
        br=max(nrs)+1 if min(nrs)>=hl else min(nrs)-1
        for c in range(W): out[br][c]=8
    else:
        ncs=[p[1] for p in (news if news else cells)]
        bc=max(ncs)+1 if max(ncs)<=vL else min(ncs)-1
        for r in range(H): out[r][bc]=8
    return out

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    hl=None; vL=None
    for r in range(H):
        if all(x==2 for x in g[r]): hl=r
    for c in range(W):
        if all(g[r][c]==2 for r in range(H)): vL=c
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    obj=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]!=bg and g[r][c]!=2]
    rs=[p[0] for p in obj]; cs=[p[1] for p in obj]
    r0,r1=min(rs),max(rs); c0,c1=min(cs),max(cs)
    out=[[g[r][c] for c in range(W)] for r in range(H)]
    if hl is not None:
        if r1>hl:   # below line -> move up to touch
            sh=(hl+1)-r0
            pos=[(q[0]+sh,q[1],q[2]) for q in obj]
            br=max(q[0] for q in pos)+1
        else:       # above line -> move down to touch
            sh=(hl-1)-r1
            pos=[(q[0]+sh,q[1],q[2]) for q in obj]
            br=min(q[0] for q in pos)-1
    else:
        if c1>vL:   # right of line -> move left to touch
            sh=(vL+1)-c0
            pos=[(q[0],q[1]+sh,q[2]) for q in obj]
            bc=max(q[1] for q in pos)+1
        else:       # left of line -> move right to touch
            sh=(vL-1)-c1
            pos=[(q[0],q[1]+sh,q[2]) for q in obj]
            bc=min(q[1] for q in pos)-1
    newcells=set((p[0],p[1]) for p in pos)
    for rr,cc,v in pos: out[rr][cc]=v
    for p in obj: out[p[0]][p[1]]=bg      # clear old object
    for c in range(W): out[br][c]=8
    return out

for p in [1,2,3,4]:
    gi,go=G[f'Demo pair {p} input'],G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    print(p, f(gi)==go)
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))

def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])

    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    hl=None; vL=None
    for r in range(H):
        if all(x==2 for x in g[r]): hl=r
    for c in range(W):
        if all(g[r][c]==2 for r in range(H)): vL=c
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    obj=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]!=bg and g[r][c]!=2]
    out=[[g[r][c] for c in range(W)] for r in range(H)]
    news=[]
    if hl is not None:   # horizontal separator
        rs=[p[0] for p in obj]
        if max(rs)<hl:              # above line -> move down to touch it
            sh=(hl-1)-max(rs)
            pos=[(q[0]+sh,q[1],q[2]) for q in obj]
        elif min(rs)>hl:            # below line -> move up to touch it
            sh=(hl+1)-min(rs)
            pos=[(q[0]+sh,q[1],q[2]) for q in obj]
        else:                       # already adjacent: no move
            pos=obj
        br=max(p[0] for p in pos)+1 if min(p[0] for p in pos)>=hl else min(p[0] for p in pos)-1
    else:                 # vertical separator
        cs=[p[1] for p in obj]
        if max(cs)<vL:
            sh=(vL-1)-max(cs)
            pos=[(q[0],q[1]+sh,q[2]) for q in obj]
        elif min(cs)>vL:
            sh=(vL+1)-min(cs)
            pos=[(q[0],q[1]+sh,q[2]) for q in obj]
        else:
            pos=obj
        bc=max(p[1] for p in pos)+1 if max(p[1] for p in pos)<=vL else min(p[1] for p in pos)-1
    for rr,cc,v in pos: out[rr][cc]=v
    for p in obj: out[p[0]][p[1]]=bg      # clear old object cells
    if hl is not None:
        for c in range(W): out[br][c]=8
    else:
        for r in range(H): out[r][bc]=8
    return out

    gi,go=G[f'Demo pair {p} input'],G[f'Demo pair {p} output']

        for c in range(W): out[br][c]=8

        for p in obj: out[p[0]][p[1]]=bg

    if hl is not None:

        if hs<hl:   # above line: move down to touch

    obj=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]!=bg and g[r][c]!=2]
    oset=set(map(tuple,obj))
    out=[[g[r][c] for c in range(W)] for r in range(H)]

    if hl is not None:                       # horizontal separator
        rs=[p[0] for p in obj]; ls,hs=min(rs),max(rs)
        if hs<hl:                              # object above line -> move down to touch
            off=(hl-1)-hs; npo=[(q[0]+off,q[1],q[2]) for q in obj]
            far=min(q[0] for q in npo)-1       # far side = top edge after move
        elif ls>hl:                            # below -> move up to touch
            off=(hl+1)-ls; npo=[(q[0]+off,q[1],q[2]) for q in obj]
            far=max(q[0] for q in npo)+1       # far side = bottom edge after move
        else:                                  # already touching
            npo=obj
            far=min(rs)-1 if max(rs)<hl else max(rs)+1
        for rr,cc,v in npo: out[rr][cc]=v
        for c in range(W): out[far][c]=8
    else:                                     # vertical separator
        cs=[p[1] for p in obj]; lc,rc=min(cs),max(cs)
        if rc<vL:                              # left -> move right to touch
            off=(vL-1)-rc; npo=[(q[0],q[1]+off,q[2]) for q in obj]
            far=min(q[1] for q in npo)-1
        elif lc>vL:                            # right -> move left to touch
            off=(vL+1)-lc; npo=[(q[0],q[1]+off,q[2]) for q in obj]
            far=max(q[1] for q in npo)+1
        else:
            npo=obj
            far=lC-1 if rc<vL else rC+1
        for rr,cc,v in npo: out[rr][cc]=v
        for r in range(H): out[r][far]=8
    return out

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    hl=vL=None
    for r in range(H):
        if all(x==2 for x in g[r]): hl=r
    for c in range(W):
        if all(g[r][c]==2 for r in range(H)): vL=c
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    obj=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]!=bg and g[r][c]!=2]
    oset=set(map(tuple,obj))
    out=[[g[r][c] for c in range(W)] for r in range(H)]
    for t in oset: out[t[0]][t[1]]=bg
    if hl is not None:
        rs=[p[0] for p in obj]; L,R=min(rs),max(rs)
        if R<hl:   # object above line -> move down to touch
            off=(hl-1)-R; npo=[(q[0]+off,q[1],q[2]) for q in obj]
            far=min(q[0] for q in npo)-1
        elif L>hl: # below -> move up to touch
            off=(hl+1)-L; npo=[(q[0]+off,q[1],q[2]) for q in obj]
            far=max(q[0] for q in npo)+1
        else:      # already touching
            npo=obj
            far=L-1 if R<hl else R+1
        for rr,cc,v in npo: out[rr][cc]=v
        for c in range(W): out[far][c]=8
    else:
        cs=[p[1] for p in obj]; lC,rC=min(cs),max(cs)
        if rC<vL:   # left -> move right to touch
            off=(vL-1)-rC; npo=[(q[0],q[1]+off,q[2]) for q in obj]
            far=min(q[1] for q in npo)-1
        elif lC>vL: # right -> move left to touch
            off=(vL+1)-lC; npo=[(q[0],q[1]+off,q[2]) for q in obj]
            far=max(q[1] for q in npo)+1
        else:
            npo=obj
            far=lC-1 if rC<vL else rC+1
        for rr,cc,v in npo: out[rr][cc]=v
        for r in range(H): out[r][far]=8
    return out
